description: Albemarle Corporation, incorporated in Virginia in 1993, is a world leader in transforming essential resources into critical ingredients for mobility, energy, connectivity and health, partnering to pioneer new ways to move, power, connect and protect. The end markets it serves include grid storage, automotive, aerospace, conventional energy, electronics, construction, agriculture and food, pharmaceuticals and medical devices. The company and its joint ventures operate more than 25 production and research and development facilities plus a number of administrative facilities, and it attributes its leading position in its industries to world-class resources with reliable and consistent supply, leading process chemistry, high-impact innovation, customer centricity and a focus on people and planet.
